name: calm
note: The default for text-led films: soft natural touches, one tuned voice for bells and text, gentle air for moves, a single struck note for the lockup. Members come from the families listeners took for recordings in earshot's blind test (taps, struck bells; the pluck is the launch film's measured kalimba) and pass the model-free audit (earshot kit check). Riser, swell, suck and drop are off: a reveal resolves on one element.

tick.note: a light fingertip on glass (80 ms tail, 466 Hz centroid): the tap family read as recorded in the blind test, where designed hover ticks were picked out

tick.crisp.note: the same glass touch, tighter (98 ms, 225 Hz body + glass partial): crisp without a synthetic tink

tock.note: a knuckle knock: the low partner of the glass tick

hit.note: the lockup as one struck C5 bell (single attack, no build, 1.9 s natural decay): a soft tonal resolve instead of a boom; set edits.pitch to the film's root

land.note: a round low thump (75 Hz body, 0.18 s): an element settling, felt more than heard

land.light.note: a soft fingertip thump for small elements landing

pop.note: an airy pop-in thump with no pitch glide: tonal pops risk the 8-bit read

whoosh.short.note: a velvet swipe: dark cloth air (227 Hz centroid), one smooth pass, no whistle

whoosh.long.note: a gentle air swell (1.36 s, peak at 0.44 s) for scene moves: air, not a sub-led designed whoosh

key.note: a thocky mechanical key, a new take per keystroke; the light / laptop members ring (comb ring in the audit)

key.space.note: the deeper, longer cap (982 Hz centroid) stands in for the space bar

key.return.note: the deep cap pressed firmer: return lands 2 dB over the space bar

click.note: a fingertip tap for cursor presses: listeners picked the designed clicks out in the blind test

click.confirm.note: a soft tuned pluck confirms: the same voice as bell and text, quieter

snap.note: a firm short knock for a lock-in (one attack); toggles were picked out in the blind test

bell.note: the launch film's kalimba on a C pentatonic: one tuned note per progress step or motif note

text.note: one soft tuned note when a text fragment resolves (not per word), rotating through the chord, under the picture

off.suck: off by default: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a build onto the reveal
off.riser: off by default: a reveal resolves on one element; add pro_riser/air_gate only if the treatment needs a build
off.drop: a calm film resolves without a sub drop; pro_sub_drop/soft tuned to the root is the restrained choice if weight is needed
off.swell: off by default: a reverse swell before a hit is a stacked lead-in
